StorageClass.title: The storage class of a bucket.

description_en: Lists all buckets owned by the requester
description_zh: 列举请求者拥有的所有存储空间（Bucket）
name: ListBuckets

parameters.help_en:
Limits the returned bucket names to those that begin with the specified prefix. If this parameter is not specified, no prefix filtering is applied.
Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
限定返回的Bucket名称必须以prefix作为前缀。如果不设定，则不过滤前缀信息。
默认值：无
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en:
Specifies that results are returned in alphabetical order starting from the first entry after the marker value. If this parameter is not specified, results are returned from the beginning.
Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回。如果不设定，则从头开始返回数据。
默认值：无
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
Limits the maximum number of buckets returned in this request.
Valid values: 1 to 1000.
Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回Bucket的最大个数。
取值范围：1~1000
默认值：100
parameters.name: max_keys

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID to which the bucket belongs
parameters.name: x_oss_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies the bucket tag key. Only buckets that have the specified tag are included in the results
parameters.help_zh: 指定Bucket标签键。列举结果中仅会包含那些打上了对应标签的Bucket
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en: Specifies the bucket tag value. If this parameter is specified, tag-value must also be specified. Only buckets that have the specified tag key-value pair are included in the results
parameters.help_zh: 指定Bucket标签值。如果请求指定了该参数，那么必须同时指定tag-value，列举结果中仅会包含那些打上了对应标签键值对的Bucket
parameters.name: tag_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies a tag list, for example: "k1":"v1","k2":"v2". Only buckets that match all tag key-value pairs in the list are included in the results.
The tagging parameter cannot be used together with the tag-key and tag-value parameters
parameters.help_zh:
指定标签列表。如："k1":"v1","k2":"v2"，只有Bucket匹配列表中所有的标签键值对，才会出现在列举结果中。
tagging参数与tag-key和tag-value两个参数不能同时存在
parameters.name: tagging
